title: PacketGridPos ZeroVector sentinel: absent, grid-origin, and dangling-FromNode packets are indistinguishable — pinned as contract
evidence: PPViewGeometry.h:69: `return FVector2D::ZeroVector; // not in this snapshot (spawned/culled)`; PPViewGeometry.h:90 (FromNode not found in Snap.Nodes): `return FVector2D::ZeroVector;`; PPViewGeometryTests.cpp:110: `TestTrue(TEXT("absent packet must yield zero"), PPViewGeometry::PacketGridPos(Snap, 999) == FVector2D::ZeroVector);`; PPRunView.cpp:366: `const bool bInPrev = PPViewGeometry::PacketGridPos(PrevSnapshot, Packet.Id) != FVector2D::ZeroVector;`
detail: A packet legitimately at grid (0,0), or whose FromNode view is missing, returns the same sentinel as absent; the view's in-prev check then misclassifies it as just-spawned (dot pops instead of interpolating). Unreachable in slice-1 fixtures (nodes at x≥2, y=2), but the test enshrines the ambiguity.
recommended_fix: Use a found-flag form (e.g. TryPacketGridPos(Snap, Id, OutPos) -> bool) and have the caller branch on the flag, never on the sentinel value.

title: Failed TestNotNull does not abort; next line dereferences the asserted pointer — regression path crashes the editor instead of red-failing
detail: UE's TestNotNull records the failure but execution continues; if the r1 regression recurs (assets null), IMC->GetMappings() null-derefs mid-suite — the editor crashes rather than reporting a clean failure. Same non-abort class at PP_Slice1SimTests.cpp (T.PipeSpan[0] after a possibly-failed ApplyDraw).
recommended_fix: After the asserts, early-return on null (if (!IMC) { return false; }) or guard the loop; branch assertions on prior state.

title: FPPSimDriver::Advance clamps only the upper bound — negative DeltaSeconds drives the accumulator negative and the tick loop runaway
detail: Negative delta (unvalidated input) makes AccumulatedSeconds negative; casting a negative double to uint64_t is UB (huge value on x86), so the while loop steps the sim toward a ~2^63 target tick — effectively a hang. The chunk's PPSimDriverTests feeds only positive deltas.
recommended_fix: Clamp both bounds: DeltaSeconds = FMath::Clamp(DeltaSeconds, 0.0f, MaxFrameDelta);

title: Diff introduces mangled shebang and drops the exec bit on static-check.py — direct-execution path fails
evidence: Line 1 of the file at the reviewed sha: `#!/ usr / bin / env python3`; diff header: `old mode 100755` / `new mode 100644` (confirmed: git ls-files -s shows 100644).
detail: The kernel reads interpreter path `/` from the broken shebang and the file is no longer executable, so ./scripts/static-check.py fails. Gate 3 is unaffected (invoked as `python3 scripts/static-check.py`), but every other invocation path of the script is broken.

title: PPProbe -ticks validated only against the lower bound — large valid values hang the commandlet
detail: Only V < 1 is rejected; -ticks=2147483647 is accepted and StepScenario executes billions of sim steps with no bound or progress guard — the probe runs effectively forever (gate hang, no fail-loud).
recommended_fix: Add an upper bound (e.g. reject ticks > 1'000'000) with the same fail-loud error path.

title: verify-capture-geometry.py: road-row x scan is unclamped — sink disc near the right edge raises IndexError
evidence:
```
        xs = [x for x in range(sx - 20, kx + 20) if img.getpixel((x, y)) == WHITE]
```
detail: The y scan is clamped (`range(max(0, sy - 15), min(H, sy + 15))`) but the x range is not: when kx is within 20px of W-1, getpixel((W.., y)) raises IndexError and the script crashes instead of reporting a geometry result.
recommended_fix: Clamp the x range to the image: range(max(0, sx - 20), min(W, kx + 20)).
